item.title: Traffic Alert: Utility Work Tonight At Highway 29 At Muscogee Road
item.description: Utility works is planned for Thursday night and early Friday morning on Highway 29 at Muscogee Road in Cantonment. FDOT said motorists may encounter intermittent turn lane closures Thursday from 8 p.m. until 5 a.m. Friday for underground utility maintenance.
